Subject: Post-demo recap + stakeholder map / PO path

Alicia / Tom — thanks again for taking the time this morning. Quick recap from our side and a few asks so we can line up procurement and legal without surprises.

TL;DR: Medivo is a strong fit for our Dedicated offering given your throughput needs. To get to an internal PO and vendor onboarding we need confirmation on the economic approver, procurement intake owner, and any additional security artifacts your team requires.

What I heard from the call:
- Use case: MedOps automation for discharge summaries (heavy throughput windows Monday mornings).
- Target go-live: pilot in Q3, production by end of Q3 (rough timeline).
- Primary technical stake: data residency within us-east, audit logs, and SOC2 evidence request.

Requests / next asks:
1) Can you confirm the economic owner (final signer) and their contact?
2) Please share the procurement intake form or the procurement contact who owns the vendor intake queue.
3) Any mandatory contract clauses (data processing addendums, IP language, or indemnity caps) we should pre-clear with Legal?
4) Will you require a standard PO before we can schedule capacity, or is a signed SOW + invoice sufficient for the pilot phase?

Attachments: I’ve attached a short SOW template and our security one-pager for procurement to review.

Suggested next steps:
- Alicia to introduce the procurement contact (if different from Tom) and economic owner via email.
- Redwood will produce a one-page procurement packet and a draft SOW for review (ETA 48 hours).
- If procurement requests specific evidence, Neha will coordinate and share the security artifacts.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick sync with your procurement lead if that speeds things up.

Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com | +1 (650) 555-0189
Redwood Inference

Thanks Dylan — good summary. Quick answers below and next steps on our side.

Stakeholders:
- Economic owner / budget approver: Meera Patel, VP Finance (meera.patel@medivohealth.com). She signs off on anything > $25k.
- Procurement intake owner: Tom Reed (cc’d) owns vendor intake. Procurement inbox is procurement@medivohealth.com for intake forms.
- Security reviewer: James Carter, InfoSec (j.carter@medivohealth.com) — he’ll need SOC2 + encryption-at-rest details.

PO / purchase process:
- For pilot (proof-of-value) we can do a signed SOW and an invoice (finance will pay on receipt). For anything > $25k we need a PO; pilot expected to be under that.
- Legal: We expect a standard DPA + our templated vendor terms for enterprise contracts. If you can provision a redlineable version of the SOW + standard T&Cs that will speed things up.

Timeline:
- Procurement intake review: ~3 business days after we get the packet.
- Finance pay schedule: Net 30 after invoice (unless procurement requires a PO).

I’ll introduce Meera and James on the follow-up email. Tom — can you confirm procurement intake SLA and whether procurement requires a vendor packet via a portal or just email?

Best,
Alicia
Head of Clinical Operations | Medivo Health
